required_edits: Replace the self-referential freshness contract with a non-self-referential binding. Record and recompute a canonical digest of the complete woven-input closure at the qualified tree, excluding generated weave evidence, and bind the live PR/release commit externally through the authenticated check-run/controller attestation. Revise the authoritative and historical mode criteria and fixtures so a woven-input change without a re-weave fails, a same-PR re-weave passes, and a stale checkout fails without requiring committed evidence to contain the SHA of the commit that contains that evidence.
hard_stops: Sections 5 and 6 of sha256:72b466d84f21756fcd9c0d7528354c6e0c18b0f0db4464e280225b9e58dba8d1 are mutually unsatisfiable: the re-weave records input HEAD A, but committing that generated evidence in the required same PR creates HEAD B; authoritative verification then requires A == B. Recording B inside the evidence changes the commit SHA again, so no woven-input slice can satisfy both exact-head verification and the atomic same-PR re-weave rule.
rationale: The canonical candidate hash independently recomputes to sha256:72b466d84f21756fcd9c0d7528354c6e0c18b0f0db4464e280225b9e58dba8d1, and its artifact bytes match matured-approach.md at git:cfa6395dff803ea557cd8de810add903d8b1788f. The prior council hard stop is substantively discharged: the Eye-signed transition now binds the chain root, verifier, workflow, controller, verdict-producer closure, and canonical covered-file set, with independent recomputation and record-reuse negatives. The remaining exact-head/self-weave contradiction is authorization-critical because it makes a required acceptance path impossible rather than merely underspecified; the plan therefore cannot be implemented AS-IS.
